claims.quote: Betta raja is a mouthbrooding labyrinth fish endemic to Sumatra, Indonesia, found in the Batang Hari and Indragiri river basins.

regions.quote: So-far Betta raja has been confirmed on Sumatra by the following sites: lowland swamp forests of the Batang Hari Basin in Jambi, the northern part of Sumatra Selatan, the Indragiri Basin in Riau and the eastern part of Sumatra Barat in Sijunjung.
